scoring_justification: The agent reports numerical results of DFT calculations which cannot be recomputed in the checker sandbox; comparing to paper-reported values with tolerances and ordering check is the appropriate tier. For the potential-dependent free energy, monotonicity and ordering are assessed structurally.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference adsorption energies, Bader charges, dipole moments from the paper (Fig. 3a, 3c) and a linear free-energy model consistent with the paper trend.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper DOI 10.1038/s41929-022-00851-x, main text and Fig. 3.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values transcribed from the paper. The free-energy CSV is linearly interpolated from the static adsorption energies with a slope of -0.3 eV/V as a minimal representative trend matching the paper's Fig. 3b.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All gold quantities are directly from the paper's reported numbers.

outputs.description: OHad adsorption energies for Li, Na, K evaluated from static DFT. The ordering and values should be consistent with the paper's findings.
Bader charges and dipole moments of OHad for each cation. The ordering should reflect increased polarization for smaller cations.
Potential-dependent OHad adsorption free energies. The correct trend (Li > Na > K) should be maintained over the potential window.

output_contract.notes: All outputs are numeric results from DFT calculations. The checker will recompute error metrics against hidden paper reference values and verify the required ordering. No further transformations are needed.

steps.ordering: Li < Na < K (more negative for Li)
steps.monotonic: non-increasing with potential_V for each cation
